item.title: Supply chain strategy must go beyond transportation, says Supply Chain Canada president
item.description: A national supply chain strategy will require a holistic understanding of what the supply chain is, which is often misunderstood, according to Martin Montanti, president and CEO of Supply Chain Canada. The post Supply chain strategy must go beyond transportation, says Supply Chain Canada president appeared first on The Hill Times.
